content: Mock-interview apps (Big Interview, Yoodli, formerly Google Interview Warmup) share: large question bank with per-question prep, record-and-review of each answer, ability to re-record, and AI/human feedback on delivery (filler words, pacing, structure). Big Interview adds an 'Answer Builder' script tool and training curriculum; Yoodli adds real-time coaching during live calls. Google's free minimal version (question + record + self-review, no scoring) was retired in 2026, suggesting demand exists for the lean version even without AI grading.
